description:
Oh San-Ho is a popular novelist on the internet, but in reality, he is a loner! He wants to be recognized in real life as much as he is on the internet, but it is not easy, and his skills, popularity, and unrequited love are all miserable in reality. Oh San-Ho writes a novel using Baek Seol-Ah, a popular girl he has always admired, as a model, and Baek Seol-Ah discovers the novel. At the moment when she is so desperate that she thinks about committing suicide, she says, "Thank you for writing with me as a model." Baek Seol-Ah compliments him, saying that she is grateful for writing with her as a model.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
